A list of books is a weak signal — anyone can buy a book. So this page tracks
what I actually did with each one: the ones I worked through with code open
next to them are marked, and several link to notes where I argue with the
author.

The abandoned ones stay on the list. Quitting a book that isn't earning its
time is a decision, not a failure.
